text:
Ava: Hey team — dropping the latest blog draft here. Need a 30m rapid pass on: hero claim, benchmark framing, webinar CTA, and lead routing. Link: https://docs.google.com/draft/REDWOOD-blog-draft (comments open).

Sam: Got it. Quick ask — can we tighten the first benchmark paragraph? feels like it overgeneralizes the perf numbers.

Ava: 100% — Sam can you suggest a sentence? I can swap it in.

Sam: Replace with: 'In our internal perf suite, the Redwood runtime reduced median token latency by ~35% compared to baseline configs at 2× throughput.' short + cite.

Priya: Love that. Also want the webinar CTA to include a session level tag so we can route registrants into the "Optimize" nurture flow. Suggest: 'Register for the Optimize launch webinar — pick your region.'

Marta: Copy edit pass done — smoothed headline, removed passive voice in lead, tightened the CTA. Left three inline suggestions in the doc.

Liam: Quick reality check on the numbers — 35% median sounds right for the 8k seq microbench we ran but add a note: "under 8k sequence microbench with quantized 4-bit models; production varies". Otherwise legal will ping.

legal-bot: FYI: Please avoid absolute claims like "fastest" or "unlimited". If you cite numbers, include methodology footnote. I left a standard clause to use.

Ava: Good call, Liam + legal-bot. I'll add the methodology blurb and a footnote with the microbench link.

Priya: Ops question — what UTM params should demand ops use for webinar signups vs blog CTAs? ops-bot can you paste the canonical mapping?

ops-bot: canonical UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=content, utm_campaign=optimize_launch, utm_term={audience_segment}, utm_content={cta_variant}. For webinar: utm_source=web, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_demo, add hs_form_guid param for HubSpot.

Ava: Perfect — I'll add that as a hidden field on the webinar form and include the tracking snippet in the post.

Marta: Also, two quick tone notes: 1) dial down product-speak in the second paragraph; 2) add one human quote from the beta partner (we have approval).

Sam: I can pull a short quote from the beta notes: "Redwood let us scale predictions without a huge spike in cost" — should be ok to push through.

legal-bot: Confirmed: beta partner quote approved for the blog. Use attribution only as agreed.

Ava: Timeline check — if we get quick passes by EOD, we can ship the publish queue tomorrow morning and trigger the webinar landing page. Can people review doc comments in the next 3 hours?

Priya: Reviewing now, will post a short list.

Liam: Quick thumbs up on numbers, will add the microbench link.

Marta: Done — accepted my edits and added the quote placement.

Ava: Awesome. Last ask: can someone sanity-check the CTA copy variants? two options in the doc, A and B. Pick one by EOD so I can lock creative.

Priya: I'm leaning B (more inclusive). B/

Sam: A feels too technical for top funnel. B/

Liam: B from me.

Ava: B it is then. Thanks everyone — I'll push changes and ping design to lock the hero image and Kadence for publish slot. :rocket:

ops-bot: Note: once published, please file the inbound playbook ticket with routing rules: blog->segment A, webinar->segment B, hs_form_guid mapping in ticket.

Ava: Added ticket to #release-playbook and invited ops. Closing thread once publish is scheduled.
note: Thread contains root message + replies; messages are in chronological order and mimic casual Slack style (short replies, @mentions, bot notes, inline code/UTM snippet).
